format: char-map txt: '# frame N MSms' blocks, '.' transparent; PNGs are 1x RGBA

conventions.coords: pixels from the top-left of the effect frame; pivot sits on the attach point
conventions.facing: all drawn facing E; for W flip x (pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/arc_*)
conventions.cell: primary: 48 px figure in a 64x64 cell, feet pivot (32,62); cell_offset = where the pivot goes in that cell for the reference pose
conventions.size_40: for a 40 px figure scale cell_offset relative to the feet by 40/48 (effects unchanged; checked in context_48.png bottom rows)

functions.afterimage: tools/fxlib.py afterimage(rgba, light=a, dark=A, alpha in {1,.75,.5,.25}, mode 2tone|1tone, rim=1): flat ghost of any frame; trail = ghosts 5 px apart at .75/.5/.25, speed lines drawn behind
functions.whiteflash: tools/fxlib.py whiteflash(rgba): 1-frame damage flash, all opaque px -> W, black outline kept

slash_h.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; cell_offset = sword hand in the slash pose
slash_h.mirror: flip x for W-facing: pivot_x -> size_w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of arc_*, cell_offset_x -> 63-x
slash_h.arc_note: arc_start = tail tip, arc_end = leading tip, arc_centre = centre of the circle through tail tip, outer bottom and lead tip, arc_mid = outer-edge midpoint; [dx,dy] from pivot
slash_h.target: 42x12 crescent (work/h_try.txt guide, hand-cleaned in work/r4E5/make.py); pivot = sword hand on the inner side 6 px left / 4 px below the lead tip; canvas at cell (9,36)-(50,47)

slash_diag.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; pivot = lead tip, cell_offset = the sword hand (low front-left, end of the downward cut)
slash_diag.mirror: flip x for W-facing: pivot_x -> size_w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of arc_*, cell_offset_x -> 63-x
slash_diag.arc_note: arc_start = tail tip, arc_end = leading tip, arc_centre = centre of curvature (approx), arc_mid = outer-edge midpoint; [dx,dy] from pivot
slash_diag.target: 37x32 downward diagonal cut, chord 45 deg (over is ~55 deg the other way): tail right of the head (cell 60,23) -> across the right hand -> lead at the sword hand (28,54)

slash_over.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; cell_offset = sword hand in the slash pose
slash_over.mirror: flip x for W-facing: pivot_x -> size_w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of arc_*, cell_offset_x -> 63-x
slash_over.arc_note: arc_start = tail tip, arc_end = leading tip, arc_centre = centre of curvature (approx), arc_mid = outer-edge midpoint; [dx,dy] from pivot
slash_over.target: ~38x40 overhead cleave from behind the bow; inner edge >= 2 px clear of bow/hair/head

hit_spark.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; head top ~(32,14), head width ~23, chest ~y40-44; default hit_point = target body_centre (32,44)
hit_spark.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, cell_offset_x -> 63-x
hit_spark.core_px: 2x2 centre at (8..9,8..9); pivot = upper-left of it

hit_flash.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; head top ~(32,14), head width ~23, chest ~y40-44; default hit_point = target body_centre (32,44)
hit_flash.note: hard 8-point star (13 px main arms; 2 px W-cored diagonal spikes with y rims grow out of the 5x5 W core, y tips), W/y only, no AA; 1 frame on the hit-stop frame, then hit_spark

speed_lines_long.note: pivot outside the canvas (canvas top-left = cell (3,22)). 4 lines, 1 px tall: W head nearest the body, p middle, n tail; f0 heads end 1 px inside the back K edge (2 px tucked under the body); line 1 has a 1-2-1 p swell (6 px) mid-length. f1 shifted back 2-3 px and re-lengthed.
speed_lines_long.with_afterimage: with afterimage ghosts k*5 px behind (3 ghosts): add [-15,0] to cell_offset so the heads meet the oldest ghost, and draw the lines behind the ghosts AND clip them to outside the ghost/figure alpha (demo work/dash_ghost_r4.png)
speed_lines_long.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; back silhouette edge (K) x21 rows 23-32, x23 row 40, x20 rows 43-48; body centre ~(32,44); shoes x28-40 (centre 34), ground_y = cell row 61 (back-shoe sole row)

speed_lines_short.note: same rows/heads as speed_lines_long, no swell; canvas top-left = cell (10,22).
speed_lines_short.with_afterimage: with afterimage ghosts k*5 px behind (3 ghosts): add [-15,0] to cell_offset so the heads meet the oldest ghost, and draw the lines behind the ghosts AND clip them to outside the ghost/figure alpha (demo work/dash_ghost_r4.png)
speed_lines_short.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; back silhouette edge (K) x21 rows 23-32, x23 row 40, x20 rows 43-48; body centre ~(32,44); shoes x28-40 (centre 34), ground_y = cell row 61 (back-shoe sole row)

dust_step.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; back foot x28-34 sole row 61 (back heel x28), front foot x35-40 sole row 60; ground_y = cell row 61 (back-shoe sole row); pivot = ground point
dust_step.mirror: flip x: x -> 13-x, pivot -> [2,13], cell_offset -> back heel of the W-facing figure; keep shading (re-stamp light top-left, do not flip pixels)
dust_step.note: f0 two merged puffs: 4x3 at the heel + 3x3 one up/back (no pebble); f1 two overlapping puffs: 8x7 front (heel side, lower, bottom 1 px above ground) drawn over a 6x6 back puff up-left, overlap 3x3 so the front top outline crosses the back puff; f2 4x4 + 3x3 overlapping, higher/further back. Width <= 14.

dust_land.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; back foot x28-34 sole row 61 (back heel x28), front foot x35-40 sole row 60; ground_y = cell row 61 (back-shoe sole row); pivot = ground point
dust_land.mirror: symmetric; no flip needed (light top-left on both sides by design)
dust_land.note: pivot x17 = first column right of the centre line (x16|x17). Each side is ONE merged billow (single outer G outline, no internal G; lobes read by u/U seams + short g creases). f0 3 lobes (low outer, low inner, top); f1 big outer + top + inner crown; f2 lifted 1, main + outer small + inner, sides separate by 2 px; f3 one merged 2-puff wisp per side (6x3 interior, single G outline, u top / U / g base), rows 2-6, outer edges x0 / x33 (2 px above f2's base).

dust_skid.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; back foot x28-34 sole row 61 (back heel x28), front foot x35-40 sole row 60; ground_y = cell row 61 (back-shoe sole row); pivot = ground point
dust_skid.mirror: flip x: x -> 26-x, pivot -> [0,10]; keep shading light top-left (re-stamp)
dust_skid.note: pivot = heel end of the trail, tucked under the back heel (cell 30,61). Tapered trail of separate G-outlined puffs, tallest at the heel and smaller toward the back, uneven gaps: f0 9x7 | 2 | 6x5 | 1 | 5x4; f1 10x8 | 1 | 6x6 | 2 | 5x4 (further back); f2 lifts and shrinks toward the back: 9x7 lift 1, 5x4 lift 3, 4x4 lift 5.

jump_whoosh.mirror: symmetric about the pivot column; no flip needed
jump_whoosh.note: ground-anchored at the take-off point. Two soft air cups '( )' bowed outward, open at the top, u/W only (paler than the n/p steel): base 2 px W/u beside the shoes (canvas x4-5 / x17-18, row 15), outer edge steps 1-1-2-4-2-1 out to x0 and curls back in, tapering to a 1 px u tip at row 4. f1: same arcs risen 3 px, cut into 3 evenly spaced 3-row curved pieces (1-row gaps): W/u low, u/u mid, 1 px u top.
jump_whoosh.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; back silhouette edge (K) x21 rows 23-32, x23 row 40, x20 rows 43-48; body centre ~(32,44); shoes x28-40 (centre 34), ground_y = cell row 61 (back-shoe sole row)

layer_split.why: far/top arc passes behind the shoes, centre row + near/bottom arc in front

land_ring.note: pivot = ellipse centre = ground point (cell 34,61). Widths 17/27/31 (shoes 13), heights 5/7/9; far arc n, ends + near shoulders u, near bottom W; runs 7-3-2 / 11-4-2-2 / 9-4-3-2-2. f2 = 6 evenly spaced dashes (5-6 px along the ring, 3 px gaps): top + bottom centre gaps, two dashes wrapping each end. Canvas bottom reaches cell row 65: do not clip effects to the cell.
land_ring.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; back silhouette edge (K) x21 rows 23-32, x23 row 40, x20 rows 43-48; body centre ~(32,44); shoes x28-40 (centre 34), ground_y = cell row 61 (back-shoe sole row)

hurt_star.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; head top ~(32,14), head width ~23, chest ~y40-44; canvas top-left sits at cell (15,0)
hurt_star.mirror: flip x keeps pivot [17,14] (the 5/3 px back stars swap sides, fine)

orbit.note: flattened, lowered orbit; depth from size (7 front / 5 mid / 3 back, orbit tilted so left side is nearer). Star bottoms at cell y11/y10 = 2-3 px above the bow / head top (y14)

hurt_star.loop: cycle f0,f1 for dizzy (reads as a 60 deg orbit step)

sweat_drop.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62), faces SE; head top ~(32,14), head width ~23, chest ~y40-44; pivot = drop tip on f0, drop body just outside / on the front (right) hair outline

throw_orb.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62); throw pose E view: hand at stride (cocked behind the head) ~(32,33), at release ~(55,35), head centre ~(40,31); cell_offset = orb at the release hand
throw_orb.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/velocity, cell_offset_x -> 63-x (spin then runs backwards, acceptable)
throw_orb.spawn: spawn at the release hand (55,35) on the release frame, then move by flight_per_unit
throw_orb.outline: K 1 px all round (reads on #6e6e6e floor and over the red dress)

throw_trail.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62); throw pose E view: hand at stride (cocked behind the head) ~(32,33), at release ~(55,35), head centre ~(40,31); cell_offset = release hand; canvas at cell (32,23)-(57,36)
throw_trail.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/velocity, cell_offset_x -> 63-x
throw_trail.arc_note: [dx,dy] from pivot; arc_start = thin tail tip behind the head (~stride hand), arc_top = apex above the head, arc_end = thick head at the release hand

throw_sparkle.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62); throw pose E view: hand at stride (cocked behind the head) ~(32,33), at release ~(55,35), head centre ~(40,31); cell_offset = release hand
throw_sparkle.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/velocity, cell_offset_x -> 63-x (symmetric, flip is a no-op)

throw_pop.cell: 64x64 C_r3 cell, 48 px figure, feet pivot (32,62); throw pose E view: hand at stride (cocked behind the head) ~(32,33), at release ~(55,35), head centre ~(40,31); cell_offset = example landing point on the ground in front of the figure (use the real landing point)
throw_pop.mirror: flip x for W-facing: x -> w-1-x, pivot_x -> w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of offsets/velocity, cell_offset_x -> 63-x (f0/f1 ring symmetric)
throw_pop.burst_note: burst centre = orb centre, 3.5 px above the ground pivot (orb radius)

slash_h_32.cell: 64x48 action cell (A_slash_f*, feet ~33,45); pivot = sword hand on smear frame f2
slash_h_32.arc_note: arc_start = tail tip, arc_end = leading tip, arc_centre = centre of curvature, arc_mid = outer-edge midpoint; all [dx,dy] from pivot
slash_h_32.flip_W: mirror x: pivot_x -> size_w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of arc_*, cell_offset_x -> 63-x

slash_diag_32.cell: 64x48 action cell (A_slash_f*, feet ~33,45); pivot = sword hand on smear frame f2
slash_diag_32.arc_note: arc_start = tail tip, arc_end = leading tip, arc_centre = centre of curvature, arc_mid = outer-edge midpoint; all [dx,dy] from pivot
slash_diag_32.flip_W: mirror x: pivot_x -> size_w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of arc_*, cell_offset_x -> 63-x
slash_diag_32.target: ~22x24, above front of head -> low front

slash_over_32.cell: 64x48 action cell (A_slash_f*, feet ~33,45); pivot = sword hand on smear frame f2
slash_over_32.arc_note: arc_start = tail tip, arc_end = leading tip, arc_centre = centre of curvature, arc_mid = outer-edge midpoint; all [dx,dy] from pivot
slash_over_32.flip_W: mirror x: pivot_x -> size_w-1-pivot_x, negate dx of arc_*, cell_offset_x -> 63-x
slash_over_32.target: ~26x28 overhead cleave, clears bow by >=2 px

hit_spark_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3, feet ~20,37, head top ~20,6, head width ~18); default hit_point = target body_centre (20,22)
hit_spark_32.core_px: 2x2 centre at (6..7,6..7); pivot = upper-left of it

hit_flash_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3, feet ~20,37, head top ~20,6, head width ~18); default hit_point = target body_centre (20,22)
hit_flash_32.note: hard 4-point star, W core, 1 px y edge, no AA; 1 frame on the hit-stop frame, then hit_spark

speed_lines_long_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3: feet ~20,37, sole row 37, back edge of body x11, body centre ~20,22)
speed_lines_long_32.note: pivot lies outside the canvas (lines trail 7..25 px behind the body centre); canvas top-left = cell (-7,12). Heads (W, 2 px tall) nearest the body at cell x8-10, tails n to the west. Flip x for facing W.
speed_lines_long_32.with_afterimage: if afterimage ghosts are drawn n px behind, add [-n,0] to cell_offset so heads start behind the oldest ghost (demo work/dash_ghost_r2.png uses -12)

speed_lines_short_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3: feet ~20,37, sole row 37, back edge of body x11, body centre ~20,22)
speed_lines_short_32.note: canvas top-left = cell (0,12); same rows as the long set, for short hops / step-dash.

dust_step_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3, feet ~20,37, back heel ~16,37, front toe ~24,36); ground_y = cell row 37 (shoe-sole row); pivot = ground point
dust_step_32.note: f0 5x4 puff on the ground just behind the back heel (cell x12-16, overlaps the heel by 1 px); f1 7x6 + 4x4 puff, rises 1-2 px and drifts back-left; f2 4x4 + 4x3 puffs higher/further back. Max width 10. flip_W: x->9-x, pivot->[-3,8], keep shading (light top-left).

dust_land_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3, feet ~20,37, back heel ~16,37, front toe ~24,36); ground_y = cell row 37 (shoe-sole row); pivot = ground point
dust_land_32.note: symmetric burst (shading not mirrored: lit top-left on both sides). f0 6x4 pair; f1 4x4 inner + 6x5 outer each side; f2 4x3 + 5x5 lifted off ground; f3 4x3 + 4x4 drifted up to the top. No flip needed.

dust_skid_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3, feet ~20,37, back heel ~16,37, front toe ~24,36); ground_y = cell row 37 (shoe-sole row); pivot = ground point
dust_skid_32.note: pivot = heel end of the trail (back heel, cell 16,37). Ground streak (3 rows g/u/g) + 2-3 puffs lifted 1-2 px, back puff curls highest; f2 streak breaks into two 4x3 ground puffs + 2 lifted puffs. flip_W: x->19-x, pivot->[0,6], cell_offset [24,37].

jump_whoosh_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3: feet ~20,37, sole row 37, back edge of body x11, body centre ~20,22)
jump_whoosh_32.note: ground-anchored at the take-off point (does not follow the figure up). Mirrored "( )" strokes, inner bases at cell x15/x25 beside the shoes, p outer / W inner, 2 px base -> 1 px tip; 1 px launch streaks under each shoe. f1: strokes 8 px tall, lifted 1 px, broken into 3 evenly spaced pieces thinning upward.

land_ring_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3: feet ~20,37, sole row 37, back edge of body x11, body centre ~20,22)

layer_split.why: far arc passes behind the shoes, near arc in front

land_ring_32.note: pivot = ellipse centre = ground point (sole row). Widths 12/16/18, heights 3/5/5; far arc n, ends + near shoulders u, near bottom W; ends 2 px thick, top/bottom 1 px. f2 = 4 thin arcs, 2 px gaps at top/bottom centre and 1 row gap at each end.

hurt_star_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3, feet ~20,37, head top ~20,6, head width ~18); canvas top-left sits at cell (8,-5) (5 rows above the cell top)

orbit.note: screen angles (y down); front star bottom ~2 px above the bow top (cell y6)

hurt_star_32.loop: f0->f1->f0 reads as orbit; or cycle f0,f1 for dizzy

sweat_drop_32.cell: 40x40 cell of the 32 px figure (A_r3, feet ~20,37, head top ~20,6, head width ~18); pivot = drop tip on f0, just outside the front (right) hair outline

throw.note: THROW group (v2/throw): orb held in hand.R until the release key, then spawned at frames.json ball.spawn_px with ball.vel_dir_px (v2/hy3d/frames_mocap/throw_<dir>/s48/frames.json); throw_trail + throw_sparkle on the release key at the hand (E-drawn; flip x for W; other views: rotate/skip per frames.json); orb spins (throw_orb loop) in flight; throw_pop at the landing point (game code).
throw.source: hand-pixelled by Opus (fx/work/throw/), char-maps in maps/
